column1: # assets/steps.tsv: one row per step of a run, read by bin/run_state.py and bin/collect_summary.py.
# step: the step number (scripts/<step>-*.sh, docs/<step>-*.md). label: as scripts/run-all.sh prints it.
# tool: the main.nf --tools name (empty: the step has none). recorded: yes when scripts/run-all.sh writes the
# step's row in logs/run_status.tsv. processes: the Nextflow processes of the step, by name without the
# workflow prefix. sections: the summary.json sections it feeds. upstream: the steps whose output it reads.
# hours: the upper end of its wall time in docs/hardware-requirements.md (runtime per step); hours_from:
# measured (the end test), estimate (the page's estimate), or empty when that table has no time for it.
# tests/test_run_state.py checks this table against run-all.sh, main.nf, modules/local and collect_summary.py.
